params._token: Address of token to add to airdrop list

params._minReceiveQuantity: Minimum amount of WETH to receive
params._rewardToken: Address of reward token to reinvest

params._status: Boolean indicating whether to allow anyone call

params._callers: Array of caller addresses to toggle status
params._statuses: Array of statuses for each caller

params._underlyingUnits: Units of underlying token to wrap

addAirdrop(address).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Adds new token to airdrop list

addWrapPair(address,address).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Adds an approved wrap pair

reinvest(address,uint256).notice: APPROVED_CALLER ONLY: Absorbs airdropped tokens and trades them for WETH

removeWrapPair(address,address).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Removes an approved wrap pair

updateAnyoneCallable(bool).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle whether anyone can call function, bypassing the callAllowlist

updateCallerStatus(address[],bool[]).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle ability for passed addresses to call only allowed caller functions

updateExchangeSettings(address,(string,b.notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Updates exchange settings for a reward token

wrap(address,address,uint256,string,byte.notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Wraps underlying token into target wrapped token
